title: mrdouglasny/OSforGFF-comparator
summary: Construction of the massive Gaussian Free Field in Euclidean spacetime of any dimension d >= 2 as a probability measure on the tempered distributions S'(R^d), and a proof that it satisfies all of the Osterwalder-Schrader axioms: OS0 analyticity, OS1 regularity, OS2 Euclidean invariance, OS3 reflection positivity, and OS4 clustering and ergodicity. The OS axioms are the conditions under which a Euclidean field theory reconstructs a relativistic quantum field theory obeying the Wightman axioms, so the free field is the base case of constructive quantum field theory on which interacting…
